mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remittance_request (sender_id, receiver_id, status, amount, created_at, expired_at) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{status}, #{amount}, #{createdAt}, #{expiredAt})

update.foreach: UPDATE remittance_request SET sender_id = #{request.senderId}, receiver_id = #{request.receiverId}, status = #{request.status}, amount = #{request.amount} WHERE id = #{request.id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, status, amount, created_at FROM remittance_request WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, status, amount, created_at FROM remittance_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, status, amount, created_at FROM remittance_request WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, amount, status, created_at, expired_at FROM remittance_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at <= #{now} LIMIT #{chunkSize}
